about_the_game:
Lost Letter

You are lost, sad, and without purpose.
Then, you find a letter lost in the world.
You don’t know who the recipient is.
You don’t know where they are.
You only know one thing: The letter must be delivered.

Lost Letter is an incremental idle game about progression, exploration, and discovery.

Start your journey by choosing a country to begin your search. Each door you knock on represents a chance to find the person who will receive the letter. Every attempt rewards you with credits to upgrade your transportation methods — from skateboards to airplanes — increasing your reach and speed across the globe.

Along the way, collect over 500 unique stamps from each country you explore, including some rare ones. Decorate your letter with these stamps in a charming collage style inspired by scrapbooking and stickers.

Every new game generates a different target, making each playthrough unique and exciting.

Key Features:

  • Relaxing incremental idle gameplay focused on exploration and upgrades

  • Collect more than 500 unique stamps from around the world

  • Unlock and upgrade multiple transportation methods to expand your search

  • Unique collage-inspired art style with paper, stickers, and scrapbooking elements

  • Dynamic, randomized targets for replayability

  • Easy controls with mouse interaction and zoom features
